verdict.rationale: Bulk-style operations are only implied by declarative and aggregate mechanisms. Terraform manages many CoreWeave resources (clusters, VPCs, buckets, inference resources) as code. Node Pools apply one shared configuration to any number of Nodes and scale them together via the autoscaler. Bucket lifecycle policies and group-based bucket policies act on many objects or principals at once. Missing for 10: explicit batch or bulk API endpoints (e.g. multi-item delete or update), bulk selection in the Cloud Console, documented examples of bulk workflows for AI agents, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
